content: FastAPI background tasks run in the same event loop as the server. The scheduled_reports_service.py runs a background asyncio loop (start_report_scheduler). _generate_report is already an async def called with await. Adding narrative calls as await generate_executive_summary(...) inside _generate_report is correct — no asyncio.run() needed or allowed (it would raise RuntimeError: This event loop is already running). The compliance_narrative_service must expose async functions and be called with await from _generate_report.
